scope: Types and five related unit files only. Common Git metadata serializes mutating operations across linked worktrees; independent repositories continue. This is preparation for snapshots and does not establish snapshot, deletion, native or distribution acceptance.
meaningfulCases: Failed held action releases shared queue without blocking independent repository
Replaced root and common directory identities reject queued mutations
Identity lookup failures reject writes and allow subsequent retry
Actual Unicode main and linked worktrees serialize while another repository switches independently; source HEAD, index and staged bytes remain exact
